Let me just call it; it says "树林 · 移动到此" which is the movement tool based at 树林, allowing travel to adjacent locations. But which destination? Probably the tool resolves to... ambiguous. Earlier moves used specific tools named for destination ("来源 酒馆"). E.g., mod_3009... "来源 酒馆 · 移动到提供此工具的地点" — destination tavern. So mod_b689... in 树林 means "move to 树林" — not useful from 树林.

The system disabled/restored tools as I move. The move tool for a destination becomes available when adjacent. Since 树林's neighbors are 医院 and 矿坑, the tools for 医院 and 矿坑 should be available.
